sectors.trend: Cybersecurity and AI infrastructure names outperform; Micron +275% YTD, AMD near $1T valuation, Palantir flashing buy signals. However, Burry's short on MU/PLTR signals potential chip cycle peak. Chinese AI rivalry threatens US model margins.
sectors.implications: AI capex cycle remains robust but rotation risk rising. Cybersecurity (CRWD, PANW, OKTA) offers relative safety within tech. Semiconductor exposure faces near-term volatility.

sectors.implications: Oil volatility directly impacts Fed path. Rising oil fuels inflation, complicating rate-cut expectations. Energy equities offer hedge against yield spike.

sectors.trend: Abbott Labs flagged as attractive opportunity. Aerospace rival outperforming Boeing/Airbus. Royal Caribbean acquires Sandals stake.
sectors.implications: Defensive healthcare rotation supported. Aerospace consolidation underway. Travel/recreation M&A signals confidence in leisure demand.

sectors.implications: Institutional crypto adoption accelerating. Regulatory clarity improving. High-beta asset class benefits from liquidity but faces volatility risk.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Shorten duration; favor floating-rate and short-duration bonds. Hedge equity with put spreads. Monitor 10Y yield as key trigger.
Reduce concentrated semiconductor exposure. Diversify into AI software/services less tied to hardware cycle. Watch MU, PLTR for breakdown.
Maintain geopolitical hedge via gold, defense equities. Avoid over-concentration in China-exposed supply chains. Monitor summit outcomes.
Energy sector as inflation hedge. Monitor Goldman's oil-linked rate model. Avoid long-duration growth if oil spikes.
Avoid media/consumer discretionary names exposed to political risk. Monitor legal outcomes for broader regulatory spillover.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Scrutinize data-center debt covenants. Favor AI names with strong FCF over capex-heavy peers. Watch Cisar commentary.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: European / EM sovereign risk (UBS, Turkey, Thames)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Limit European bank exposure. Avoid Turkey-linked credit. Monitor Swiss political developments.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce semiconductor concentration; hedge MU/PLTR exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Burry shorting both names citing chip down cycle. MU up 275% YTD is extended. Supply constraints at Fabrinet signal tightening.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Shorten bond duration; favor T-bills over long-dated Treasuries
defensive_moves.rationale: 10Y at 2007 highs, Barr signals more hikes. US buying back $6B longer-dated Treasuries but market pricing further hikes. Capital preservation priority.
CD rates up to 4.40% APY. In uncertain rate environment, liquidity is optionality. Mortgage rates still >7% limit housing leverage.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid overexposure to China-linked equities pre-summit
defensive_moves.rationale: US-China summit this week is binary event. Chinese AI rivalry threatens US margins. Geopolitical risk elevated with Iran aftermath.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Diversify away from single-name tech concentration
defensive_moves.rationale: S&P 500 near record but leadership narrow. Santoli notes bull relies on familiar names. Small caps leading dip signals rotation risk.

market_outlook.short_term: Cautious. 10Y yield at 2007 highs and Fed hike expectations create headwinds. S&P 500 near record but vulnerable to yield-driven selloff. US-China summit this week is key binary catalyst. Oil volatility and political noise (media ban) add noise. Expect 2-4% range-bound volatility. Small caps may continue leading dips.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but bifurcated. AI capex cycle and cybersecurity demand support tech leadership. Housing recovery and consumer value rotation offer breadth. However, chip cycle peak risk (Burry), data-center debt overhang, and potential Fed tightening cap upside. 6-12 month: S&P 500 likely tests new highs but with wider dispersion. Favor quality, FCF-positive names over speculative AI capex plays.
